[[Droknar's Blades]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] obtained from the [[Assassin's Chest]] at the [[Epilogue]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 3
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Deldrimor Blades]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Shiro's Blades]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they require 13 [[Dagger Mastery]].
*[[Chkkr's Pincers]], [[Faveo's Daggers]], [[Claws of the Kinslayer]], and [[Stygian Daggers]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Piercing damage]].
